commands.name: GSM CS BER Measurement Mode

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: BER selects Bit Error Rate measurement mode. Only the confirmed BER token is recorded; other modes remain to be completed from the matching GSM Signaling Command Reference.

commands.source: R&S application note 1MA194, GSM CS BER remote command example
commands.description: Set or query the GSM circuit-switched BER measurement mode.
commands.notes: Configure BER mode before sample count / stop condition and before INITiate:GSM:SIGN:BER:CSWitched. Kept in a dedicated BER catalog to avoid overwriting concurrently updated gsm_signaling.json.
